issues.title: Audio controls rendered on marker track
issues.description: Non-audio marker track displays audio monitoring and mute/solo controls.
issues.evidence: Track 'Markers · T1' displays M/S buttons and a VU level meter.
issues.suggestion: Hide audio-specific metering and solo/mute toggles for marker tracks.
issues.triageNote: Real component defect: TrackHeader rendered the VU level meter and M/S squares for every trackType, including text/marker lanes; fixed by hiding audio-only affordances (M/S + meter) for trackType="text" while keeping the L lock square.

issues.title: Inverted negative timeline markers
issues.description: Negative time offset axis markers render with inverted negative signs under RTL direction.
issues.evidence: Timeline displays '30 s-', '60 s-', and '90 s-' instead of '-30s', '-60s', '-90s'.
issues.suggestion: Enclose time offset values in directional isolation tags.
issues.triageNote: Misattributed: the '-90s/-60s/-30s' labels are rendered by the eval page's own shared time-axis row (src/app/eval/pair-168/page.tsx), not by TrackHeader, which emits no time text; the bidi fix (dir="ltr" or <bdi> per offset) lives in a forbidden file.
